title: madengine cluster profile
description: Facts about a cluster, as opposed to the shape of a job. Merged after the SLURM shape presets and before the user's own configuration. A null value removes an inherited key.

facts.description: Node facts a submit node cannot always discover for itself, e.g. when the login node has no GPUs.

gpu_architecture.description: e.g. gfx942; used in place of probing when the submit node has no GPU.

gpu_product_name.description: e.g. AMD Instinct MI300X; reported in results when probing is not possible.

hip_version.description: HIP/CUDA version of the compute nodes, e.g. 6.4.

shared_filesystem.description: Filesystem types df reports for shared storage on this cluster.

fabric.description: Interconnect the collectives run over, e.g. roce, infiniband, ethernet.

slurm.description: Scheduler facts, e.g. whether GPU GRES is advertised. Site policy such as partition or account belongs in the user's configuration, not in a shared profile.

env_vars.description: Transport and runtime variables. Values are rendered into a shell command, so they must be scalars; null removes a variable a shape preset set.
